edges.reason: Both refer to Renee Good's age as 37.

edges.label: refines
edges.reason: The NEW occurrence describes the officer firing into the windshield ('fires'). The EXISTING occurrence describes the officer firing 'two more times'. The NEW reports a subset of the total firing sequence, making it narrower. Although the quotes themselves don't name the publisher, they are identical in source metadata (same evidence_id and evidence_source_id), establishing they are from the same report.

edges.sentence: On 2026-10-01, PBS NewsHour reported “The officer, who is now very close to the open window on the driver's side, fires two more times, fatally shooting Renee Good, according to an analysis of the videos by The Associated Press and others.”; on the same day, PBS NewsHour reported “One officer standing in front of the vehicle pulls his weapon and fires into the windshield.”.

On 2026-10-02, NPR reported “The 37-year-old was fatally shot by a federal agent during an immigration enforcement operation in Minnesota.”; on 2026-10-01, Reuters reported “Good, 37, was shot dead in her car by a US Immigration and Customs Enforcement agent on January 7 when she and her wife joined one of the city's daily protests against masked and armed federal agents deployed to Minnesota to arrest migrants for deportation.”.
